message:
Command `cd /workspace && cp repo-vul/src-vul/font-corpus/AdobeVFPrototype-Subset.otf poc.bin && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/ftfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":239,"var":"data/size","code":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput( const uint8_t* data, size_t size )","note":"Attacker-controlled font bytes enter the fuzz target as a single raw input buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/ftfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":260,"var":"face","code":"FT_New_Memory_Face( library, data, size, 0, &face )","note":"The input buffer is parsed as a FreeType face object, so malformed font tables influence later parsing."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/ftfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":360,"var":"face->charmap","code":"for each selected face and size, iterate over all glyphs using the active charmap","note":"The fuzzer exercises character-map and glyph-loading code paths on the attacker-supplied font."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/base/ftobjs.c","function":"FT_Get_Next_Char","line":3738,"var":"cmap->clazz->char_next","code":"gindex = cmap->clazz->char_next( cmap, &code );","note":"FreeType dispatches to the format-specific char_next implementation chosen from the parsed cmap table."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/sfnt/ttcmap.c","function":"tt_cmap2_char_next","line":496,"var":"table/subheader","code":"subheader = tt_cmap2_get_subheader( table, charcode );","note":"For cmap format 2, the code walks attacker-controlled subheader data from the font's cmap table."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/sfnt/ttcmap.c","function":"tt_cmap2_char_next","line":520,"var":"p","code":"idx = TT_NEXT_USHORT( p );","note":"The loop advances through subheader entries and reads glyph indices from the font-controlled table without a separate bounds check here."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/base/ftobjs.c","function":"FT_Get_Next_Char","line":3740,"var":"gindex","code":"do { gindex = cmap->clazz->char_next( cmap, &code ); } while ( gindex >= (FT_UInt)face->num_glyphs );","note":"The returned glyph index is used to continue iteration, so a malformed cmap can drive repeated reads through the table until the sink is reached."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/ftfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":396,"var":"glyph_index","code":"if ( FT_Load_Glyph( face, glyph_index, flags ) ) continue;","note":"The fuzz target then loads glyphs selected from the parsed cmap, reaching the memory-safety sink in the vulnerable parser path."}
]
